newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ecobank launches speedy W.African money transfers.
newsitem.headline: Ecobank launches speedy W.African money transfers.

text.p: Ecobank, a bank owned by the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) in collaboration with the private sector, said on Tuesday it had launched a product that guaranteed same-day transfer of funds across West Africa.
"Rapidtransfer" will ensure that funds received before a given cut-off time will be available for collection the same day at eligible Ecobank branches.
Funds received after the cut-off time will be available for collection by 10 a.m. local time on the next working day.
An Ecobank official said the cut-off time would differ in each country, depending on local closing times.

Ecobank's headquarters are in Togo and "Rapidtransfer" will be available there as well as its branches in Benin, Burkina Faso and Ivory Coast. It will be expanded to Ecobank's branches in Ghana and Nigeria subject to exchange control regulations there.
It will also be made available to other African countries where Ecobank is not currently present but where it has correspondent banks.

Ecobank has thrived since it was set up in 1985. It reported a post-tax profit of $14.9 million for 1996, up 20 percent from 1995. Total assets exceed $500 million. -- Alan Raybould, Abidjan newsroom, +225 21 90 90
